title: Juice N Power Cherry Ice Power 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Cherry Ice Power By Juice N Power’s is a bold blend of luscious, sweet cherries and invigorating menthol, delivering a taste that’s irresistibly sweet and satisfying while also being deliciously refreshing. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks.
